findings.claim_broken: The zero-pool refusal is killed locally, with nothing sent to AWS. Under a mutant that accepts PREPARATION_CONCURRENCY=0, the worker in this case goes on to HeadBucket against the public AWS S3 endpoint: environment() sets no S3_ENDPOINT_URL. Exit is 2 either way, so only the name assertion kills.
findings.evidence: A control run with PREPARATION_CONCURRENCY=2 and the same environment() exits 2 with `S3_MEDIA_BUCKET did not answer HeadBucket (403)` (AWS answering the MinIO literal credentials). The hand mutant (name removed from MUST_BE_POSITIVE) dies at :671 `(2, "... INFO botocore.credentials Found credentials in environment variables...`. The lane's own death line for main_zero_preparation_pool_accepted shows the same. Disclosure: my control run and my L3 hand mutant each made one such HeadBucket (403) with the non-secret MinIO literals.
findings.minimal_fix: Pass S3_ENDPOINT_URL="http://127.0.0.1:9" in that case's environment(...), so a mutant fails locally. Optionally assert the refusal text rather than exit 2 alone.

findings.claim_broken: The file's rule, 'a hang is an assertion here, not a stuck run', is not kept. the_lease_is_renewed_while_preparation_runs (:425) and the_default_renewal_keeps_a_long_preparation_alive (:453) await gate["asked"] with no bound. A defect that never reaches /tokenize hangs those cases instead of failing them.
findings.evidence: Hand mutant claim_preparation -> claim: pytest sat in test_prep_worker__the_lease_is_renewed_while_preparation_runs for more than 10 minutes (the newest pytest tmp dir was that case) until I killed it. With those two cases deselected, the same mutant dies in 11 named cases.
findings.minimal_fix: `assert await within(gate["asked"].wait(), 5.0) != "timed out"` in both cases.

findings.claim_broken: Moving `prepare` into the long-lived worker assumed nothing else changed. In fact MediaPreparation.prepared_by_job now grows by one entry per prepared video job for the life of the worker process. Its only remover, media/gc.py, is composed nowhere (the evidence's Limit 5 names the unswept disk cache, not this map).
findings.evidence: Service-free probe: after each of 5 prepared video jobs, len(prep.media.prepared_by_job) is 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. grep: prepared_by_job is written only at prepare.py:453 and read only by media/gc.py, which neither worker/__main__.py nor gateway/pilot.py composes.
findings.minimal_fix: After `self.media.prepare(...)` in PreparationRunner._media, pop the job's entry (`self.media.prepared_by_job.pop(job_id, None)`): nothing in the worker reads it. Or record it with Limit 5.
